name: naive-unless-and-negation
description: `unless {isPrivate}` as `not (isPrivate = true)`, `!context.is_authenticated` as `not (is_authenticated = true)`, and no has-blocked guard on the owner: Cedar skips a policy whose condition errors on a missing attribute.
ve: (((@action equals @create_document) and (@resource equals @drive)) or (((@action equals @view_document) and (@resource ea_owner @principal)) or (((@action equals @view_document) and ((there exists entity acl, ((@resource ea_viewacl acl) and (rtc[parent](@principal, acl)))) and (not (@resource is bt_isprivate)))) or (((@principal equals @public) and ((@action equals @view_document) and (((@resource sa_publicaccess @s_view) or (@resource sa_publicaccess @s_edit)) and (not (@resource is bt_isprivate))))) or (((@action equals @modify_document) and (@resource ea_owner @principal)) or (((@action equals @modify_document) and ((there exists entity acl, ((@resource ea_modifyacl acl) and (rtc[parent](@principal, acl)))) and (not (@resource is bt_isprivate)))) or ((((rtc[parent](@action, @edit_is_private)) or ((rtc[parent](@action, @add_to_share_acl)) or (rtc[parent](@action, @edit_public_access)))) and (@resource ea_owner @principal)) or ((((rtc[parent](@action, @add_to_share_acl)) or (rtc[parent](@action, @edit_public_access))) and (there exists entity acl, ((@resource ea_manageacl acl) and (rtc[parent](@principal, acl))))) or (((@action equals @create_group) and (@resource equals @drive)) or (((rtc[parent](@action, @modify_group)) or (rtc[parent](@action, @delete_group))) and (@resource ea_owner @principal))))))))))) and (not ((((rtc[parent](@action, @view_document)) or ((rtc[parent](@action, @modify_document)) or ((rtc[parent](@action, @edit_is_private)) or ((rtc[parent](@action, @add_to_share_acl)) or ((rtc[parent](@action, @edit_public_access)) or (rtc[parent](@action, @delete_document))))))) and ((@principal is has_blocked) and (there exists entity o, ((@resource ea_owner o) and ((o es_blocked @principal) or (@principal es_blocked o)))))) or ((not (@context is bt_is_authenticated)) or ((there exists entity o, ((@resource ea_owner o) and (not (@principal equals o)))) and (@resource is bt_isprivate))))).
